title: anthyllis vulneraria subsp. baldensis
intro: Anthyllis vulneraria subsp. baldensis, commonly known as Kidney Vetch, is a flowering plant species belonging to the legume family (Fabaceae). It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to aid in wound healing, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Kidney Vetch include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects, making it a potential remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Kidney Vetch include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
